thread:
nora_finance: Heads-up: Customer 'Vectorify' dispute on invoice INV-2026-07-04. They were billed ~2.1M tokens on Jun 30 but their dashboard shows ~700k. Can someone check whether rate-limited/429 retries were counted as billable?

tim_billing: Pulling invoice rows now. Invoice line items show 2,100,000 generation_tokens for 2026-06-30. Ledger shows 700,200; export file shows 2,100,000.

sam_support: Vectorify reported many 429s around 2026-06-30T18:00Z and said their client retried without idempotency keys. They sent logs showing repeated requests with same payload but different client ids.

billing-bot: rate-limit-event summary: 2026-06-30T17:58Z-18:05Z -> 13k 429s across region-us-east-1; export-run #exp-20260704 included all requests as billable.

olga_api: We intentionally count successful tokens only, but our export pipeline currently counts any accepted request record in request_log table, which includes 'throttled' rows that later had successful retries. It looks like the ingestion writes a row for the initial 429 attempt and then another for the successful retry. If client retries without idempotency, both can be counted.

nora_finance: So cause: clients retried and both attempts recorded as billable tokens. We should consider credits where the original attempt returned 429 (not served) and subsequent success was the only effective work.

tim_billing: Quick query: SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM request_log WHERE customer='vectorify' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-06-30T17:58' AND '2026-06-30T18:06' AND status IN ('429','200'); -> 2,100,000 tokens. Filter status=200 -> 700,200. That matches.

kevin_cfo: We should credit the 429 attempts if they were failed at ingress. Approve provisional credit up to $12k for customer experience. Exact amount to be calculated by billing.

sam_support: Vectorify says they didn't set idempotency keys because their SDK default wasn't configured. They want a credit and a note about best practices.

olga_api: Short-term engineering fix: 1) change exporter to mark entries with status != 200 as non-billable unless a successful duplicate isn't present 2) add a job to reconcile windows with high 429:200 ratios and collapse duplicates where payload_hash matches and only count the successful one. Longer-term: require idempotency keys in SDK.

tim_billing: Action plan: 1) issue credit memo CM-2026-07-04-VECTORIFY for tokens billed on 429-only attempts (ETA 4h) 2) run a reconciliation job for Jun 30 window to recompute billable tokens (ETA 2h) 3) add export rule to ignore non-200 rows by default (owner: olga_api)

billing-bot: credit-request #cr-2026-07-04-vectorify created by tim_billing

nora_finance: Please post the final credit amount here before sending to the customer. Also prepare a short KB for account reps about advising customers to use idempotency keys.

sam_support: I'll send Vectorify an explanation and the timeline. They asked for a small goodwill credit while we fix the exporter.

olga_api: I'll push the exporter patch to staging now and schedule a sweep for the 17:58-18:06 window.

nora_finance: Thanks all. Keeping thread open until credit memo posted and reconciliation job completes.
